title: Interpretation Graph — Structured Output Contract
description: The only shape a model response may take under the bounded prompt composer pilot. No markdown, no code fence, no preface/postscript, no chain-of-thought field. usedContextRefs must exactly echo the compiled context packet's own refs — a model may narrate, never invent a new reference.
$comment: Deliberately absent keys, enforced by additionalProperties:false: reasoning, analysis, thoughtProcess, rationaleChain, confidence, confidencePercent, spiritualAccuracy. No chain-of-thought field exists in this contract by construction, not just by instruction.
